title: Sebastian and the Archive
author: Gideon Pemberton
blurb: Wendell Montrose, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
